a.title: The first Nvidia RTX Spark mini PCs launch today from Asus, Dell, and MSI

b.lede: MSI's EdgeMesa N AI+ brings Nvidia RTX Spark N1X power to a Windows-on-Arm mini PC with 128GB of unified memory, strong local AI performance, and the ability to game on the side. But its high $7,499 price isn't that much cheaper than more versatile DGX Spark systems.
